name: Tabata This
description: Five Tabata intervals of rowing, air squats, pull-ups, push-ups and sit-ups, with a minute of rest after each of the first four. You score the lowest interval for each movement.
source_notes: crossfit.com/workout/2015/01/11 (official CrossFit daily workout archive), retrieved 2026-10-16; 1 minute of rest after each of the first four movements, score the lowest interval for each movement (calories on the row) and add them
